description: Curated reference list of the most commonly prescribed medications in the United States (generic names), used to screen a genome against the pharmacogenomic databases bundled with this project.
source_note: Compiled from public U.S. dispensed-prescription-volume statistics (ClinCalc DrugStats / national prescription-audit summaries, ~2020-2023). Generic names; ranks are approximate and provided only as a reference menu. Pharmacogenomic relevance for each drug is NOT taken from this file — it is computed at run time from drug_database.json (CPIC/DPWG) and cpic_data (ClinPGx/PharmGKB). Drugs with no entry in those databases are reported as 'no known pharmacogenomic interaction', never as a fabricated finding.
